item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Food is fuel, and how you eat shapes how the rest of the day goes. Skip the perfect plan. Look at what's coming: a busy stretch, a few gaps, and an evening that needs you steady. Decide now when you'll eat, so hunger doesn't decide for you. Aim for real protein and something green at your next meal. Your one action: pick that meal, and put it on your schedule before noon.
